name: Caraway Ceramic-Coated Large Baking Sheet
description: Caraway large ceramic-coated baking sheet in cream. The Amazon listing says the sheets are free of PTFE, PFOA, and PFAS. The brand page says the coating is ceramic on an aluminized steel core, made without PTFE, PFOA, or PFAS, and oven safe to 550°F.
features: Amazon ASIN B0B78DWPLJ is the cream large sheet, 18 by 13 inches. The material field says aluminum. A bullet says the baking sheets are free of PTFE, PFOA, PFAS, lead, and cadmium. The same bullet says oven temperatures up to 550°F and hand washing.

Caraway's large-baking-sheet page says the core is aluminized steel, the coating is two layers of ceramic, and the coating is made without PTFE, PFOA, or PFAS. It says the sheet is oven safe up to 550°F and hand wash only.
Caraway's materials page says the ceramic coating is third-party tested for over 600 types of forever chemicals and names Light Labs. This directory has not reviewed a report.
labelNote: The no-PFAS sentence is the brand's, repeated on the Amazon bullet. 550°F is above the 500°F line Health Canada prints for nonstick bakeware. This directory has not tested the coating.
